name: Bezitramide
summary: Bezitramide is an opioid analgesic. Bezitramide itself is a prodrug which is readily hydrolyzed in the gastrointestinal tract to its active metabolite, despropionyl-bezitramide. Bezitramide was discovered at Janssen Pharmaceutica in 1961. It is most commonly marketed under the trade name Burgodin.

pharmacology.text: Bezitramide itself is a prodrug which is readily hydrolyzed in the gastrointestinal tract to its active metabolite, despropionyl-bezitramide.

uses.text: It is most commonly marketed under the trade name Burgodin.

sideEffects.en: Like other strong opioids it causes drowsiness, nausea, constipation and slowed breathing, and overdose can be fatal. Because it is slow to take effect, repeated taking before it works can lead to overdose.
sideEffects.zh: 和其他強效鴉片類一樣，它會造成嗜睡、噁心、便祕與呼吸變慢，過量可能致命。由於起效緩慢，在作用出現前重複服用可能導致過量。
sideEffects.zhHans: 和其他强效鸦片类一样，它会造成嗜睡、恶心、便秘与呼吸变慢，过量可能致命。由于起效缓慢，在作用出现前重复服用可能导致过量。

fact.en: It is inactive as swallowed and only becomes a painkiller once the gut cuts a propionyl group off it. It was discovered at Janssen, the same laboratory that produced fentanyl.
fact.zh: 貝齊米特在吞服時沒有活性，必須等腸道切下一個丙醯基後才成為止痛藥。它是在楊森實驗室發現的，芬太尼也出自同一實驗室。
fact.zhHans: 贝齐米特在吞服时没有活性，必须等肠道切下一个丙酰基后才成为止痛药。它是在杨森实验室发现的，芬太尼也出自同一实验室。
